title: Everything Announced at November 2026 Product Update Briefings
body_markdown:
The future of technology for social impact is not a growing collection of disconnected tools. It’s a modern, intelligent platform where data and workflows are connected, artificial intelligence is embedded throughout the experience, and trusted agents can increasingly help move work forward, all on a foundation built with security and data governance at its core. That’s what Blackbaud is building with the Platform for Good.


Our November Product Update Briefings offered the latest look at that platform taking shape. Across fundraising, finance, payments, marketing, grantmaking and education, we’re modernizing critical experiences and connecting systems so information and work can move more seamlessly. We’re embedding AI into everyday workflows to help customers understand and act on their data, while purpose-built agents are beginning to automate increasingly complex tasks with human oversight. The result is more than a collection of new capabilities: it’s a more connected and automated technology foundation designed to simplify the customer technology landscape, lower total cost of ownership and create more capacity for mission impact.


##### Blackbaud Raiser’s Edge NXT®


Built around the way modern fundraising teams operate, Raiser’s Edge NXT combines connected data, embedded intelligence, automation, and extensibility in a single experience that helps organizations identify opportunities faster, deepen donor relationships, and operate more efficiently. The solution provides a flexible foundation for the future of fundraising that delivers continuous innovation without disruptive upgrades or data migrations.


**Data Health Agent Early Adopter Program** : Blackbaud’s next Agent for Good has begun its Early Adopter Program (EAP) for Raiser’s Edge NXT customers in the United States. This agent is a data steward that transforms data cleanup from a series of reactive projects into a continuous, guided process. The Data Health Agent continuously assesses a customer’s Raiser’s Edge NXT data against a defined catalog of data health rules, flagging issues and presenting a prioritized list of recommended fixes that can easily be approved by a human reviewer and executed by the agent. Over time, the Agent can be directed to act with increasing levels of autonomy at the direction of the fundraising data expert acting as the Agent Manager. By continuously identifying data-quality issues and presenting prioritized fixes for human review, Data Health Agent can reduce time spent on manual data cleanup and give teams more capacity for higher-value work.


**Recognition Programs** help fundraising teams steward donors through giving societies without the manual upkeep. Donor levels are calculated and maintained automatically, so fundraising teams can spend less time tracking membership and more time thanking and engaging supporters. Lifetime programs (for cumulative giving) and Loyalty programs (for consecutive or total years of giving) will be released in the new year, with Annual giving societies to follow. Together with Legacy programs for planned giving, these programs in Raiser’s Edge NXT give organizations a single place to recognize donors at every stage of their relationship.


**New Goals and success management capabilities** in Raiser’s Edge NXT will give fundraising teams new ways to measure and optimize fundraising progress. New visual tools will connect goals that organizations set with their fundraising progress in Raiser’s Edge NXT. These will allow fundraisers and managers to more clearly understand where they stand, identify where attention is needed, and act sooner to course correct and achieve important goals. This proactive approach to fundraising management reduces the time required to understand performance using traditional reporting tools while building in data-driven recommendations on next steps.


**Enhancements to the Raiser’s Edge NXT** Work Center will create a more personalized, role-based experience that helps fundraising teams focus on what matters most. Building on the Work Center capabilities customers use today, the expanded experience brings portfolio activity, opportunities, stewardship, goals, and performance signals together around each user’s role and responsibilities. Frontline fundraisers can more quickly see where to focus their attention and move relationships forward, while fundraising leaders gain greater visibility across their teams to identify where support or action may be needed. The result is a more connected experience that helps turn the fundraising intelligence already in Raiser’s Edge NXT into clearer priorities and more productive action.


**Fundraising Pages** give nonprofits a fast, simple way to turn their biggest giving moments into a single, cohesive donor experience. These branded giving pages stimulate giving by bringing together goal meters, a recognition wall, and donation form on one dynamic page. Donors see their impact build in real time and feel part of something bigger. Fundraising Pages are available for the end-of-year 2026 giving season.


**A re-designed event registration experience** lets supporters sign up for multiple events through a single guided flow. This new registration experience lets supporters attending a weekend event sign up for a gala, a golf outing, and Sunday brunch through one form, with one checkout process. Attendees get a simpler experience, and organizations can expect smoother sign-ups and a more connected relationship from the first click. The new experience is planned for the first half of 2027.


All Raiser’s Edge NXT customers will get upgraded email tools in 2027. They add more merge fields, conditional fields, expanded consent options and standard and mobile previews. Customers also get enhanced design tools, AI chat assistance, video embedding and richer open/click reporting. These come as part of the existing subscription.


We’ve expanded the capabilities of Lists, the popular segmentation tool in Raiser’s Edge NXT. New **List Exploration and AI analysis** tools are available now, allowing users to build charts and pivots on constituent and gift lists. And Blackbaud AI Chat can answer questions about a List in plain language.


**Blackbaud Marketing™ is a new AI-native, multi-channel marketing solution built inside Raiser’s Edge NXT** . Donor data, marketing plans and channel performance all live in one system, with no exports and no rebuilding lists. Customers describe a goal in plain language and the AI drafts a multi-channel plan for the team to review. Benchmarks draw on Blackbaud Institute sector data. It will initially be released to US customers.


##### Blackbaud Financial Edge NXT®


**The Accounts Payable Agent takes shape.** Blackbaud shared more detail on how the Accounts Payable Agent in Financial Edge NXT® will work alongside AI-powered Document Intelligence. Document Intelligence turns emailed and uploaded invoices into draft invoices by pulling out vendor, amount, date and GL coding. The agent then takes it from there:


- reviewing drafts and escalating exceptions
- building payment runs that respect cash reserves and spending preferences
- explaining every decision in a reviewable log


Payment Assistant™ then pays the runs that are approved. Finance teams approve every payment run, so the agent proposes and people decide.


**Payment Assistant™ powered by BILL is now in an Early Adopter Program.** Eligible U.S. Financial Edge NXT customers can now pay vendors through BILL’s business payments network from inside their existing Payment Assistant workflow. Approvals and reconciliation stay where they are today.


**Deposit Connect™ is expanding beyond fundraising.** Deposit Connect is now in limited availability for Raiser’s Edge NXT® and Blackbaud Integrated Payments, where it records gift deposits in Financial Edge NXT automatically. It is progressing toward general availability. Blackbaud also plans to extend the same automated deposit experience to Blackbaud Billing Management™ and Altru® in the future.


**Reconciliation with less manual work.** Reconciliation Assistant matches bank and ledger activity automatically, clears high-confidence matches with a full audit trail, and surfaces only uncertain items for review. It is entering an Early Adopter Program. A Reconciliation Agent is planned to find and resolve the transactions that integrations can’t match.


##### Blackbaud Enterprise Fundraising CRM™


Enterprise fundraising teams are managing increasingly complex relationships, data, and workflows while facing growing expectations to engage supporters more personally and operate more efficiently. Blackbaud Enterprise Fundraising CRM is evolving to create a more connected and intelligent fundraising experience, bringing together the data, workflows, and AI-powered capabilities teams need to move from insight to action with greater confidence.


**Development Agent for Blackbaud CRM** Early Adopter Program is coming in early 2027 for those in the United States. Development Agent is designed to help large charities, healthcare foundations and academic institutions extend personalized engagement to more donors while keeping organizational strategy and human oversight at the center.


**Blackbaud AI Chat** will make it easier for fundraisers to access information and move work forward. Through natural conversation, fundraisers can understand constituent and relationship context, prepare for upcoming conversations, and complete everyday tasks with fewer disconnected steps.


**Intelligent Prospect Management and Fundraising Intelligence** will bring insights and action together across the fundraising journey. These AI-powered experiences are designed to help teams more easily identify, research, and prioritize prospects, surface relevant opportunities and signals, and connect insights with recommended next steps and existing fundraising workflows.


**Development Agent** will help organizations using Blackbaud Enterprise Fundraising CRM expand their fundraising capacity with responsible, agentic AI. Designed to work alongside fundraising teams, Development Agent will help extend personalized engagement to more mid-tier donors while keeping organizational strategy, data, and human oversight at the center.


##### Blackbaud Altru®


**Building the Future of Blackbaud Altru** : Arts and cultural organizations are managing increasingly connected relationships with patrons who may visit, become members, participate in programs, attend events, and ultimately support the mission in new ways. Blackbaud Altru is evolving to help organizations connect those interactions around a more complete view of each patron, while making everyday work simpler for staff and experiences more seamless for the people they serve.


**Enhanced ticketing and membership experiences** will make it easier to turn visits into lasting relationships. Planned improvements will simplify how patrons find and purchase tickets, interact with their memberships, and access important information, while giving staff clearer, more streamlined ways to manage the experiences behind the scenes.


**A direct Financial Edge NXT™ integration** will create a more connected path from revenue to reconciliation. Altru activity across ticketing, memberships, donations, and point of sale will move directly into a Financial Edge NXT journal batch, reducing reliance on export-based processes and giving financial teams a simpler, more controlled way to review and transfer activity.


**AI-powered experiences** will help organizations turn patron information into action. Blackbaud is exploring natural-language assistance and patron intelligence that can help staff understand trends, surface opportunities, prepare for the day ahead, and move more easily from information to the next best action.


##### Blackbaud Billing Management™


**Billing Management – Collections Assistant Generally Available.**


Empower billing staff with AI-powered intelligence and a unified dashboard to track overdue accounts and automate personalized outreach — all in one place to determine next steps and recover revenue faster.


**Transaction records available via SKY API**


Schools can connect their billing data to their third-party systems without manually exporting and importing files.


##### Blackbaud Tuition Management™


**In Product Refunds**


Easily refund payments back to the originating account within the product. No more manual checks sent back to payers or offsetting fees needed.


**Payment Plan Improvements**


Coming soon, school users will have access to control their payment plans when needed with added functionality to split tuition across specific set percentages by plan month.


##### Blackbaud Financial Aid Management™


**Parent Financial Aid Application**


One modern application, from choosing a school to submitting. Families confirm a school’s application is available and can add or change schools without starting over. One homepage tracks status, documents and messages for ease of use and user experience.


**Financial Aid for SGOs**


Blackbaud SGO Suite will be one place for an SGO to run its whole scholarship process, from family application to approved award, all within financial aid


##### Blackbaud Enrollment Management System


**Tuition Refund Protection via Vertical Insure**


Simplify tuition insurance and take the management burden off your own staff and let Vertical Insure handle the paperwork. This seamless integration is embedded in your existing contract signing experience and follows your own insurance requirements per payment plan.


****


**Enrollment Product**


Soon you will be able to keep your existing Admissions records flowing seamlessly into Billing Management with only the enrollment tools you need, and none of the clutter you don’t.


****


**Admissions Agent**


Schools will be able to use their own content and engagement rules to give families personalized answers and proactive guidance throughout admissions.


##### Blackbaud Student Information System and Blackbaud Learning Management


**Student Success Insights**


Student Information users will be able to calculate a student’s risk using data points from across the


Student Information and Learning Management Systems, allowing schools to provide appropriate


interventions and supports to ensure student success.


**Reporting Transformation**


**Course Reporting**


Soon teachers and department chairs will be enabled with actionable insights concerning the courses under their purview. Department chairs can easily compare how different sections of a course are performing and teachers can easily see analytics about their own course sections.


**Feedback Generator**


Teachers will be able to provide even more feedback than was possible in the past through the use of AI. Equipped with the wealth of data already found in the Learning Management System, the tool helps to create personalized, individualized feedback for students on assignments and report cards.


##### Blackbaud Core Features:


**Chat for Blackbaud AI**


Out Now! Retrieve user data, create advanced lists, find tools for infrequent tasks, enter new records (e.g. absences) and generate data comparisons and summaries – without ever leaving the page. Streamline tasks so you can focus on students.


Throughout this coming transformation, all of your Education data will be in a single place which will allow for more advanced queries, visual reporting, reduced latency, natural language query, chat-to-chart, and predictive analytics – based on all of your data.


**Total School – Common Records Engine**
Seamlessly flow common records from your Education office to your Advancement office. And updates to common data flow in both directions automatically and immediately. Keep students, parents, grandparents, siblings, faculty and more in sync with less work.


##### Blackbaud Award Management


Students and award administrators will soon benefit from a modernized applicant experience designed to make applications easier to navigate, complete and manage. Enhancements include streamlined navigation, auto-saving, persistent contextual support, and accessibility-focused design informed by WCAG 2.1 standards.


##### YourCause® from Blackbaud


**YourCause is delivering new ways for organizations to operate corporate impact programs with greater speed, visibility, and insight.** Expedited giving helps accelerate the movement of funds to nonprofits, while the Processing Portal gives CSR teams greater transparency into donation processing. Innovations across volunteering and groups continue to strengthen employee engagement, and upcoming major releases of the Microsoft Teams YourCause bot and new mobile app will keep driving the next generation of engagement forward. New and coming-soon AI-powered functionality, including form intelligence and application summaries for grant managers and tools designed to support faster disaster relief response and employee engagement, provides opportunities to reduce manual effort and expand engagement.


##### Blackbaud Integrated Payments


Blackbaud Integrated Payments handles payments inside Blackbaud solutions from the moment a supporter gives to the moment finance closes the books. The latest updates help organizations raise more, save more and worry less. They add more ways for donors to give, smarter protection behind every transaction and a more connected path from gift to general ledger.


**More ways for donors to give.** Apple Pay, Google Pay and PayPal let donors give with one tap on Blackbaud giving forms and checkout, and Venmo is available for U.S. organizations. Showing PayPal at checkout has been shown to incrementally raise total conversions. Amazon Pay is live today in Luminate Online® and TeamRaiser® and is coming to Online Giving. DAFpay will let donors give straight from their donor-advised funds at checkout, starting with the SKY Payments API.


**Donor Cover, your way.** The new Donor Cover Configuration will let organizations decide whether Donor Cover is opt-in or opt-out by default. They can also set the ask rate separately for credit card and direct debit gifts. Organizations set it up once in Blackbaud Integrated Payments, and it applies to all eligible online forms. It will be released in limited availability first.


**Direct debit for sustainers in four markets.** Direct debit now works in the U.S., U.K., Canada and Australia. It’s fully connected to Online Giving and to the automated recurring giving engine in Raiser’s Edge NXT®. Soon, organizations in the U.K., Australia and Canada will be able to turn their existing manual direct debit gifts into automated payments.


**Payments wherever supporters show up.** With the MobilePay Terminal app and Tap to Pay, volunteers can take payments on their own iPhone or Android phone, so there’s no hardware to buy. That means shorter lines at galas, auctions and walks in the U.S. The S700 smart reader becomes the main terminal for Altru® and the SKY Payments API in early 2027. The Blackbaud Marketplace also has more than 40 partner solutions for auctions, canvassing, text-to-give and more, so organizations can add these tools without adding another payment processor.


**Protection and performance in the background.** A layered, AI-powered defense runs on every online transaction. It includes automated bot detection, IP threat checks and risk scoring that looks at more than 80 data points. Always-on optimization, including Adaptive Acceptance, Automatic Card Updates and Network Tokenization, has been shown to raise authorization performance. Smarter retry logic will help recover more failed recurring gifts.


**Faster answers for finance with Blackbaud AI Chat.** In the Integrated Payments portal, users can ask Blackbaud AI Chat in plain language for a list of transactions or the details of one transaction. Next, AI Chat will also show the Raiser’s Edge NXT gift ID and fund linked to a transaction. A new disbursement export will show disbursement and gift details in one report, and a Microsoft Power Platform connector will bring payments data into automated workflows. Along with Deposit Connect™, these updates help finance teams reconcile from gift to deposit faster.


##### Blackbaud Luminate Online and TeamRaiser


**A modern foundation for digital fundraising.** Luminate Online and TeamRaiser are being modernized in stages from the end of 2026 through 2027, bringing nearly 30 years of fundraising depth into a simpler, more intuitive experience.


**TeamRaiser Vision** streamlines event creation through a guided experience that can take teams from a blank slate to a live event in minutes, with no coding required.


**TeamRaiser Dashboard and Participant Center 4** give participants one place to see their lifetime impact across events.


**Optimized Donation Forms for TeamRaiser** provide donors with a simpler, more focused giving experience, while **Blackbaud ID (BBID) for Luminate Online** provides administrators with a more streamlined sign-in experience.


**Brand Kits** help organizations maintain consistency by defining colors, typography and logos once, then reusing them across events.


**AI Content Writer & Tone Enhancer** helps teams draft and refine donation forms, emails and TeamRaiser pages while maintaining a consistent organizational voice.


##### Blackbaud Grantmaking™


**Building What’s Next for Blackbaud Grantmaking:** Funders are facing growing demands while navigating increasingly complex grantmaking processes. Blackbaud Grantmaking is evolving to help organizations meet those demands with a more scalable, connected foundation that can support continued innovation. The modernized architecture is designed to deliver greater flexibility and connectivity while enabling Blackbaud to bring new capabilities, including trusted AI-powered experiences, to customers faster. This direction aligns with Blackbaud’s broader vision for AI that brings together data, sector-specific context, and appropriate controls to help social impact organizations move their work forward with confidence.


**Unified AI-powered insights** will make grantmaking information easier to access. A shared AI assistant will help funders surface key insights, starting with read-only reporting across applications, programs, awards, payments, and funds, while respecting existing user permissions. This will help teams more easily engage with information across the grantmaking lifecycle while maintaining established controls.


**A Financial Edge NXT integration** will create a more connected path from grant award to payment. By reducing duplicate data entry and errors, the enhanced integration will help funders move faster, strengthen auditability, and gain a more connected view across grantmaking and financial operations.


**AI-generated application summaries** will help grant teams focus their time where it matters most. Built directly into Blackbaud Grantmaking, the capability will quickly surface key application information, helping teams spend less time reviewing lengthy submissions and more time evaluating opportunities and advancing their mission.
